phase9EInvariantVerifiedForReuse.question: Did Phase 9E intend the raw provisional Competitive Rating to remain private until placement?
phase9EInvariantVerifiedForReuse.answer: YES, and 9F must preserve it publicly.
phase9EInvariantVerifiedForReuse.evidence: competitive_leaderboard() returns only accounts with rated_matches >= 5 AND unique_opponents >= 3, so a provisional rating has never reached any public surface. competitive_rank_of() returned NULL for a public-but-provisional account in the live certification (data/validation/9e/rating-rls-live.json, leaderboardPrivacy.p0). The account owner's own view does show their provisional rating (LeaderboardPage), and that stays.
phase9EInvariantVerifiedForReuse.consequence: A PUBLIC 9F profile of a provisional player shows COMPETITIVE / PROVISIONAL and the placement progress counts only — no rating number, no rank, no estimate. This is stricter than 'no rank' and is the correct reading of the accepted 9E contract.

knownBaselineFlake.test: e2e/phase7b-preview.spec.js — 'P1: Ready and Postgame show the SAME pregame read' (candidate3-preview project)
knownBaselineFlake.detail: Failed once in the full suite with 'the stored read is reused verbatim'; the whole spec file then passed 6/6 standalone. A Phase 7B surface, unrelated to Phase 9F. Playwright already runs workers:1 retries:0, so this is a genuine intermittent rather than a parallelism artifact.
knownBaselineFlake.decision: NOT masked. The shared Playwright retry setting is left alone, because raising it would hide failures for every phase. Instead scripts/profiles/phase9fSweep.sh re-runs a failing spec once ALONE and records whether it passes alone (intermittent) or fails alone (a real failure), so the final report can tell them apart.
